reply_text: Sofia, I replied in the thread under your message. Bettina's Nov 17, 2025 posts gave 12%, then a correction to 10%, which she said came from a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. The latest figure posted is 10%, but nothing in the channel confirms it as the settled term. For the renewal brief, check the signed order form or amendment, or confirm with June before you rely on it.
